articles.title: Bollywood Actor Jugal Hansraj Struggle Life: कधीकाळचा नॅशनल क्रश, निळ्याशार डोळ्यांचा तो एक राजहंस; आपल्या लूक्सनी शाहरुख-सलमानलाही द्यायचा टक्कर, रेखा यांच्यासोबतच्या फोटोतल्या सुपरस्टारला ओळखलंत?
articles.description:
Bollywood Actor Jugal Hansraj Struggle Life: 'मोहब्बतें' (Mohabbatein Movie) सिनेमातील अभिनेता जुगल हंसराज (Jugal Hansraj) तुम्हाला नक्कीच आठवत असेल. ज्यानं आपल्या आकर्षक निळ्याशार डोळ्यांनी कित्येक तरुणींना घायाळ केलेलं. अभिनेता जुगल हंसराज यानं फारशा सिनेमांमध्ये काम केलं नसलं तरी, आपल्या 'चॉकलेट बॉय' इमेजमुळे त्यानं आपल्या कित्येक चाहत्यांच्या हृदयात आपलं एक खास स्थान निर्माण केलेलं. सध्या सोशल मीडियावर जुगल हंसराजचा लहानपणीचा एक फोटो व्हायरल होतोय, ज्यामध्ये तो बॉलिवूडची सदाबहार अभिनेत्री रेखा (Actress Rekha) हिच्यासोबत दिसतोय. या फोटोमध्ये जुगल खूपच लहान आणि गोंडस दिसतोय.

जुगल हंसराज हा एक असा बॉलिवूड अभिनेता (Bollywood Actor) आहे, ज्यानं केवळ आपल्या अभिनयानंच नव्हे, तर आपल्या हास्यानं आणि आकर्षक व्यक्तिमत्त्वानंही चाहत्यांना भूरळ घातलीय. एकेकाळी त्याला 'नॅशनल क्रश' मानलं जायचं आणि तो बड्या स्टार्सना टक्कर देईल असं वाटत होतं, मात्र, असं असूनही त्याला दीर्घकालीन यश मिळालं नाही आणि लवकरच तो बॉलिवूडच्या झगमगाटातून मागे पडला.

View this post on Instagram

रेखासोबत दिसणारा सुपरस्टार कधीकाळी होता अनेकांच्या गळ्यातील ताईत (Mohabbatein Movie Actor Jugal Hansraj)

अभिनेता जुगल हंसराजचा रेखासोबतचा बालपणीचा एक फोटो समोर आला होता आणि त्याला खूप पसंती मिळालेली. सोशल मीडियावर या दोघांचे अनेक फोटो उपलब्ध आहेत, ज्यावरून जुगल हंसराज आणि रेखा यांच्यातील घट्ट नातं दिसून येतेय. सध्या व्हायरल होत असलेला फोटोही अत्यंत मनमोहक आहे. या फोटोमध्ये रेखा जुगल हंसराजला प्रेमानं मिठी मारताना आणि खूप आनंदी दिसतेय, तर जुगलही तिच्याकडे पाहून स्मितहास्य करतोय. हा सुंदर फोटो नक्कीच तुमची मन जिंकेल. अनेक चाहत्यांनीही या फोटोवर लाईक्स आणि कमेंट्सचा वर्षाव केलेला.

लहानपणापासूनच करतोय फिल्म्समध्ये काम (Who Is Actor Jugal Hansraj?)

जुगल हंसराज याला लहानपणापासूनच अभिनयात आपलं नशीब आजमवायचं होतं. त्यानं कित्येक फिल्म्समध्ये चाईल्ड आर्टिस्ट म्हणून काम केलेलं. दरम्यान, एक वेळ अशी होती, जेव्हा जुगल हंसराज याच्या क्युटनेसवर शाहरुख, सलमान आणि आमिर खान पेक्षाही जास्त तरुणी फिदा होत्या. सध्या जुगल हंसराज फिल्म्सपासून पूर्णपणे दूर आहेत. सध्या ते अमेरिकेत सेटल्ड झालेत. जुगल हंसराज आपली पत्नी जास्मिन आणि मुलासोबत अमेरिकेत राहतात.

articles.title: "The way I experienced life....": Tom Brady's ex-wife Gisele Bündchen shares how New England Patriots years changed her forever
articles.description: Gisele Bündchen has revealed that moving to Boston during Tom Brady's New England Patriots years transformed her outlook on life. Reflecting on that chapter, she said the quieter lifestyle helped her find balance, become more present and shift her focus away from constant achievement. Despite their 2022 divorce, Bündchen says those years remain deeply meaningful, shaping both her personal life and professional perspective while raising a family with Brady.

articles.title: Bradley Cooper and Gigi Hadid spark wedding buzz- WATCH
articles.description: Bradley Cooper and Gigi Hadid have sparked secret wedding rumors. The couple was photographed wearing matching gold bands on their left ring fingers. This sighting occurred in Paris after a workout session together. News of a possible wedding follows Gigi's friend Taylor Swift's recent nuptials. Cooper and Hadid began their relationship in October 2023.

articles.title: Quote of the day by Immanuel Kant: 'Less luxury is the key to good health. The shorter you sleep, the longer you live' - A life lesson that explains power of self-control by the German philosopher
articles.description: The Quote of the day by Immanuel Kant, “The shorter the sleep, the longer they live; less luxury brings health,” reflects the philosopher's belief in discipline, moderation and purposeful living. The article explains the meaning behind the quote, traces it to Kant's Lectures on Anthropology delivered at the University of Königsberg between 1772 and 1789, and explores how his strict daily routine shaped his thinking. It also looks at Kant's life, his major philosophical works, and why his ideas on ethics, reason and self-discipline continue to influence people around the world

articles.title: Vivek Oberoi fails to respond in personality rights case: Report
articles.description: The Delhi High Court has observed that actor Vivek Oberoi appears to have stopped participating in the proceedings of his personality rights lawsuit after securing an interim injunction earlier this year. The observation came during the hearing of an application filed by X Corp, which sought to exclude two posts on the social media platform X from the scope of the interim order passed in Vivek's favour on February 5.

articles.title: Bill Maher Draws Lindsey Graham Comparison In Unfiltered Joke After Trump's Eulogy Draws Heat
articles.description: Donald Trump's emotional eulogy for late Senator Lindsey Graham has sparked a nationwide debate after his unscripted remarks at the memorial service drew mixed reactions. The conversation took another turn when Bill Maher addressed Graham's funeral on Real Time, joking that he and the late senator shared one thing in common: both made it to 70 without getting married. Here's how Trump's tribute and Maher's comments reignited political debate across the US.

articles.title: The mob cannot seize the stage
articles.description: Stand-up comedy has become an unlikely barometer of free expression in India. The latest instance is comedian Kunal Kamra's Bengaluru performances, shifted from Whitefield to Koramangala after an obscure outfit objected to the show.

articles.title: Where Is Melania Trump? Sudden 'Disappearance' Fuels Fresh 'Marriage Trouble' Questions
articles.description: Melania Trump is once again at the center of public attention as experts weigh in on her noticeably limited public appearances and what they could mean for her future beyond the White House. A PR expert has described her position as "a very difficult line to walk," suggesting she faces the challenge of building her own identity while remaining closely tied to the Trump brand. Here's why her low profile is sparking fresh speculation.

articles.title: Jimmy Kimmel's Future Hanging By A Thread? FCC Takes Aim At ABC | WATCH
articles.description: Jimmy Kimmel is facing what could become the biggest battle of his late-night career. The FCC is reportedly preparing unprecedented license reviews targeting ABC-owned stations, while Disney and ABC accuse the agency of political retaliation over Kimmel's comedy and criticism of President Donald Trump. Could this legal showdown reshape American television forever? Watch the full story as we break down the FCC controversy, ABC's explosive response, Trump's feud with late-night TV, and what's at stake.

articles.title: Quote of the day by Roald Dahl: 'The adult is the enemy of the child because of the awful process of...' - inspiring quote by Matilda, James and the Giant Peach and The BFG author teaches life lessons on growing up, parenting and why childhood needs both freedom and guidance
articles.description: Quote of the day by Roald Dahl: Roald Dahl's quote describes adults as the enemy of children during socialization. This perspective reflects the reality of teaching societal rules and moral behavior. Learning kindness and responsibility takes time, and adults guide this essential development.
